note: This lesson covers Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels as applied inside Microsoft Fabric: what a label is and its typical tiers, the sensitivity bar / flyout and Settings-pane paths to apply or change one, default vs. mandatory label policies (both configured centrally in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal at purview.microsoft.com, not in Fabric), downstream inheritance to reports/dashboards built on a labeled item, and label/protection persistence on supported export paths (Excel, PDF, PowerPoint, Analyze in Excel, .pbix download) versus unsupported paths like CSV. All facts cross-checked directly against the Microsoft Learn pages listed in 'research' above, current as of this verification date. Five of six downloaded screenshots are genuinely screenshot-rich real UI (the sensitivity bar flyout, the Settings pane, the Purview admin wizard, and lineage view) — well above the 3-screenshot floor.
